operator_requirements: Refresh preflight no more than five minutes before a read; bind the exact ref, operation and client source hashes
Reconcile daily budgets and approved exceptions before any HTTP catalog request
Reserve and record each request; this manifest and single-read CLI are not a durable shared budget coordinator
Coordinate metrics and bounded SQL activity samples in the same window without overlapping CE-1 remote work
Stop after any failed or invalid response, missing telemetry, pressure alert or resource limit; do not retry or cancel unrelated sessions
Keep synthetic latency/error counts separate from production user traffic and mobile rendering
Correlate infrastructure, locks, swap/pressure and catalog samples before proposing CE-100 closure
